verdict.rationale: Stagehand documents a dedicated user-data best-practices page. A local user data directory persists after shutdown, so the next run starts with the same cookies and local storage. For Browserbase sessions, contexts persist browser data across runs, which directly lets agents skip repeated logins. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of session persistence, and deeper documentation detail on reusable named profiles (e.g., managing multiple contexts, handling session expiry).
